status: Task COMPLETE - All 7 targets verified. Three critical corrections made: (1) validation.NewAllStrings chains validators [step 46], (2) desktop.App single interface [step 50], (3) Hyperlink.OnTapped replaces URL opening [step 53]. All requirements met.

knowledge.content: Target 1 - AppMetadata struct fields (in root fyne package, app.go): ID string, Name string, Version string, Build int, Icon Resource. Default values: ID="com.example", Name="Fyne App", Version="1.0.0", Build=1
Target 1 - App.Metadata() method must be added to App interface, returning AppMetadata. SetMetadata(m fyne.AppMetadata) function goes in app/meta.go sub-package
Target 2 - JSON theme functions in theme package: FromJSON(data string) (fyne.Theme, error) and FromJSONReader(r io.Reader) (fyne.Theme, error). On parse error, return default theme + error

Target 2 - JSON hex color formats (with or without # prefix): 3-digit (abc→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xff), 4-digit (abcd→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xdd), 6-digit (a1b2c3→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xff), 8-digit (a1b2c3f4→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xf4). Color resolution order: variant-specific (Colors-dark/Colors-light) first, then generic Colors, then default theme

Target 2 - JSON theme schema top-level keys: Colors (map color name→hex), Colors-dark, Colors-light, Sizes (map size name→float32), Fonts (map style→URI, styles: "regular", "bold", "boldItalic", "monospace"), Icons (map icon name→URI)

Target 3 - NewSprintf(format string, b ...DataItem) String in binding package (data/binding/sprintf.go). Supports Bool, Bytes, Int, Float, Rune, String, URI bindings. Set() uses fmt.Sscanf for reverse parsing. Bytes cannot be round-tripped (error), URI parsed via storage.ParseURI
Target 3 - StringToStringWithFormat(str String, format string) String: if format is "%s" (identity), return original binding directly without wrapping. Otherwise delegate to NewSprintf(format, str)
Target 4 - MenuItem additions (in root fyne package, menu.go): Icon Resource field, Shortcut Shortcut field. Menu.Refresh() and MainMenu.Refresh() methods must update all windows displaying the menu

Target 5 - Toolbar constructor return type changes in widget package (widget/toolbar.go): NewToolbarAction returns *ToolbarAction (not ToolbarItem), NewToolbarSpacer returns *ToolbarSpacer, NewToolbarSeparator returns *ToolbarSeparator. Add ToolbarAction.SetIcon(icon fyne.Resource) method

Target 6 - Container.RemoveAll() sets Objects to nil and triggers re-layout. Container.Add(nil) must be no-op (don't append nil). Hyperlink.OnTapped func() field: when non-nil, call it instead of opening URL. Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(count int): overrides default 3 rows for multi-line entries

Target 6 - validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator) fyne.StringValidator in data/validation package (data/validation/all.go). Runs all validators in order, returns first error or nil if all pass
Target 7 - desktop.App interface in driver/desktop/app.go with methods: SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu), SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource)
